root_cause: Large-window Brotli keeps the format-level 62-bit distance alphabet but must cap the decoded alphabet to BROTLI_MAX_ALLOWED_DISTANCE before distance offsets are converted into int distance_code.
effect_path: A large-window stream selects high distance codes beyond the calculated safe limit; ReadDistanceInternal computes b->dist_offset[code] + extra bits and narrows it to int, then ProcessCommandsInternal uses the wrapped distance in dictionary or ringbuffer copy logic before the intended max-distance rejection can reliably classify it.
